title: Increase product bento
description: A two-tone lead statement over a framed bento of pale grey 16px-radius panels: one full-width panel with a two-column list of payment rails (32px icon tiles, the first filled mint; others fill on hover) beside a product picture, then two rows that alternate 7:5 and 5:7. Each panel's picture is a white card that runs off its bottom and side edges. Stacked on phones.
notes: media per panel: pass a screenshot, mock-up or video; empty it is a plain white card at the original's size and position
five panels fill the layout exactly (1 + 2 + 2); more continue the alternating pairs
the product mock-ups' own motion (number rolls, sheen, live dot) is not rebuilt
